ROD_SELF_CLEARANCE.raw_gate: Every stored branch/pair minimum raw clearance must remain strictly positive.
ROD_SELF_CLEARANCE.aggregation: minimum over the unchanged same-branch and cross-branch candidate domains
ROD_SELF_CLEARANCE.reason: The v1 denominator was the unrelated global characteristic length, while the formal same-branch exclusion domain is defined by local diameter plus clearance.

BOB_SOCKET_RADIAL_MONOTONICITY.raw_gate: Every material cell must retain r dot delta-r > 0.
BOB_SOCKET_RADIAL_MONOTONICITY.aggregation: minimum cell cosine on the unchanged socket material domain
BOB_SOCKET_RADIAL_MONOTONICITY.reason: The v1 raw dot product shrinks with material-cell span while its denominator remains a global length squared; the local direction cosine is dimensionless and mesh-span invariant.

ALL_OTHER_COMPONENTS.normalization: Temporarily unchanged from the frozen v1 metadata solely so the two demonstrated scale pathologies can be re-evaluated reproducibly.
known_review_targets: MINIMUM_SEGMENT_LENGTH and AERODYNAMIC_CHORD_LENGTH are cell-size quantities and require a local-rest-span audit before promotion.
The remaining clearance and socket-extent components require a systematic local-scale audit rather than failure-driven selection.

retroactivity: none; v1 run status and source provenance remain unchanged
dynamic_requirement: Any future trajectory qualification must evaluate this candidate contract on accepted steps or a separately verified continuous certificate; prepared-state re-evaluation is insufficient.
promotion_requirement: Formal source/spec modification requires explicit model-owner authorization, a complete all-component scale audit frozen before new runs, and fresh numerical qualification.
design_principle: Qualification margins should be dimensionless distances from the unchanged raw zero, normalized by the local geometric quantity that defines that guard rather than by an unrelated apparatus-wide length.
selection_bias_control: Passing the two components that previously failed is not sufficient promotion evidence. This hybrid evaluation remains diagnostic until every guard component has been classified and tested for similarity and mesh-objectivity under one predeclared rule.
